section.$comment: section in column A, e.g. 'State — default'

check.$comment: check text in column B; should IMPLY its oracle ('matches Figma node X')

statuses.$comment: one entry per platform sub-column, in block order. '' = not run YET this round (temporary; MUST carry a comment). 'Skipped' = will NOT be run on this platform — feature absent, screen unreachable, blocked and won't unblock — a decision (MUST carry a comment with the reason). Never invent other values; the Sheet dropdown knows only these three. The mobile result column may render 'Partial' (some active platform still empty) — that is a computed value, NOT a status, and never appears here.

comment.$comment: column E area; REQUIRED when: any status empty, any Failed (bug link), or sources contradict (even if Passed)
